Four Stabbed in London; Woman Arrested

Four people were stabbed in London's Covent Garden area on Wednesday. A woman was arrested at the scene on suspicion of possession of an offensive weapon and assault. Metropolitan Police stated they believe the incident was related to mental health. The stabbings occurred around lunchtime in the busy tourist area. One report identified the arrested woman as Stella Gollovena, 47, who was charged with four counts of wounding with intent to cause grievous bodily harm.
